brief:
Ramz Alkbarof, the United Nations' acting special coordinator for Middle East peace and humanitarian affairs coordinator for the occupied Palestinian territory, warned of an intensifying humanitarian crisis in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Alkbarof did not specify which conditions were worsening or outline steps toward resolution.

The warning comes as Gaza has endured prolonged conflict and restrictions on aid flows, leaving the territory facing severe shortages in food, medicine, and basic services.
